recipes.name: Garlic oil noodles
recipes.description: Slippery noodles tossed in fragrant garlic oil with a squeeze of lime.
steps: Boil the noodles until just tender, then drain and rinse briefly.
Warm oil in a pan and cook sliced garlic until golden and crisp.
Toss noodles into the pan with soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
Fold in chopped green onion and finish with lime if you like.

recipes.name: Tomato fish skillet
recipes.description: Gentle white fish simmered in a bright tomato and onion sauce.
steps: Soft-cook onion in oil, then add garlic, ginger, and turmeric.
Stir in chopped tomatoes and simmer until saucy.
Nestle fish pieces into the sauce and cover until cooked through.
Season with salt and scatter cilantro before serving.

recipes.name: Chickpea tofu scramble
recipes.description: Crumbled tofu with turmeric, onion, and chickpeas for a filling plate.
steps: Crumble tofu into a hot oiled pan with onion and garlic.
Dust with turmeric, salt, and pepper, then stir until lightly golden.
Add drained chickpeas and warm through.
Finish with green onion and eat over rice if you have it.

recipes.name: Coconut chicken noodle bowl
recipes.description: Soft noodles in a mild coconut broth with shredded chicken.
steps: Brown chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and ginger in a pot.
Pour in coconut milk and broth, then simmer until chicken is tender.
Shred the meat, return it to the pot, and season with fish sauce.
Cook noodles separately, divide into bowls, and ladle the broth over.
Squeeze lime on top if you want extra brightness.

recipes.name: Cabbage pork stir-fry
recipes.description: Crisp cabbage and ground meat cooked hot with garlic and soy.
steps: Brown the ground meat in oil, breaking it into small bits.
Add garlic, then piles of shredded cabbage.
Stir-fry until cabbage softens but still has bite.
Season with soy sauce and salt, then top with green onion.

recipes.name: Spinach egg curry
recipes.description: Wilted spinach in a light curry with soft boiled eggs.
steps: Boil eggs until just set, cool, and peel.
Cook onion and garlic in oil with turmeric and cumin.
Add spinach in handfuls until wilted, then season with salt.
Nestle eggs into the greens and warm through.
Swirl yogurt at the end if you want it creamier.

recipes.name: Thai basil chicken
recipes.description: Peppery basil and garlic with ground chicken over hot rice.
steps: Fry garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add ground chicken and cook until no pink remains.
Season with fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar.
Kill the heat and fold in Thai basil until wilted.
Serve over rice if you have a pot ready.

recipes.name: Quick tom yum shrimp
recipes.description: A hot-sour broth with shrimp, mushrooms, and lime.
steps: Simmer broth with bruised lemongrass, lime leaves, and chili.
Add mushrooms and cook a few minutes.
Slip in shrimp until they turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Scatter cilantro and serve steaming.

recipes.name: Green curry vegetables
recipes.description: Coconut green curry loaded with eggplant and beans.
steps: Warm a splash of coconut milk in a pot until it looks oily.
Add remaining coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar.
Simmer eggplant, beans, and pepper until tender.
Fold in Thai basil and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Tofu pad Thai night
recipes.description: Rice noodles with tofu, egg, and a sweet-sour tamarind glaze.
steps: Soak noodles until pliable, then drain.
Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden and set aside.
Scramble eggs in the pan, add noodles and the tamarind-fish-sugar mix.
Toss with tofu, sprouts, and green onion.
Top with crushed peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp fried rice
recipes.description: Day-old rice wok-tossed with shrimp and plenty of garlic.
steps: Scramble eggs in oil, push aside, then cook shrimp and garlic.
Add cold rice and break up clumps over high heat.
Season with soy sauce and white pepper.
Finish with green onion and serve hot.

recipes.name: Cool cucumber salad
recipes.description: Crisp cucumber with chili, fish sauce, and lime for a side dish.
steps: Slice cucumber and shallots thin.
Whisk fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and sliced chili.
Toss vegetables in the dressing.
Top with peanuts and cilantro if using.

recipes.name: Kimchi fried rice
recipes.description: Sour kimchi and rice crisped in a hot pan with a fried egg.
steps: Chop kimchi and fry it in oil until edges darken.
Add rice and gochujang, pressing so some grains crisp.
Drizzle sesame oil and fold in green onion.
Fry eggs separately and slide on top with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Weeknight bulgogi skillet
recipes.description: Thin beef steak glazed with soy, garlic, and a touch of sugar.
steps: Slice steak thin across the grain.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and sesame oil, then coat the beef.
Sear onion strips, then the beef in a hot pan until browned.
Scatter green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Soft tofu doenjang stew
recipes.description: A bubbling bowl of soft tofu in savory soybean paste broth.
steps: Dissolve doenjang into simmering broth with garlic.
Add onion and zucchini and cook until soft.
Spoon in soft tofu in big chunks.
Crack an egg on top if you like, then finish with green onion and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Sesame spinach side
recipes.description: Blanched spinach dressed with sesame, garlic, and soy.
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil and blanch the spinach briefly.
Drain, rinse with cold water, and squeeze out excess moisture.
Toss with minced garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve cool or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Glass noodle japchae lite
recipes.description: Chewy glass noodles with spinach, carrot, and mushrooms.
steps: Soak or boil glass noodles until chewy, then drain.
Stir-fry onion, carrot, and mushrooms separately until tender.
Wilt spinach quickly and season everything with soy, sugar, and sesame oil.
Toss noodles with the vegetables until glossy.

recipes.name: Weeknight miso soup
recipes.description: Comforting miso broth with soft tofu and wakame.
steps: Warm dashi gently and soak wakame until soft.
Add cubed tofu to heat through.
Turn off the heat and whisk in miso until smooth.
Top with green onion and serve right away.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon pan
recipes.description: Salmon glazed in a sticky soy-mirin sauce.
steps: Sear salmon skin-side down until crisp, then flip.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and garlic.
Pour the glaze into the pan and reduce until sticky.
Baste the fish and finish with green onion and sesame.

recipes.name: Chicken egg rice bowl
recipes.description: Soft-set eggs and chicken simmered over a bowl of rice.
steps: Simmer sliced onion and chicken in dashi, soy, and mirin.
When chicken is cooked, pour beaten eggs over the top.
Cover until eggs are softly set.
Scoop over hot rice and garnish with green onion.

recipes.name: Ginger pork plates
recipes.description: Thin pork with a punchy ginger-soy pan sauce.
steps: Slice pork thin and sear quickly in oil.
Stir ginger, soy, mirin, and sugar, then pour into the pan.
Toss until the meat looks glossy.
Serve with shredded cabbage on the side.

recipes.name: Vegetable udon stir
recipes.description: Thick udon noodles with bok choy and mushrooms.
steps: Loosen udon in hot water and drain.
Stir-fry mushrooms and garlic, then add bok choy.
Toss noodles with soy and mirin until coated.
Finish with a drop of sesame oil if you like.

recipes.name: Garlic bok choy
recipes.description: Crisp-tender bok choy blasted with garlic oil.
steps: Halve bok choy and rinse well.
Sear cut-side down in hot oil, then flip.
Add garlic and a splash of water to steam briefly.
Season with soy sauce and salt.

recipes.name: Egg drop spinach soup
recipes.description: Silky egg ribbons in a light broth with spinach.
steps: Bring broth to a simmer and season with salt and white pepper.
Stir cornstarch with a spoon of water and thicken the broth lightly.
Drizzle beaten eggs in while stirring to make ribbons.
Add spinach to wilt, then sesame oil and green onion.

recipes.name: Weeknight mapo tofu
recipes.description: Soft tofu in a chili-oil sauce with a little ground meat.
steps: Brown ground meat with garlic and ginger.
Add chili oil, soy sauce, and crushed Sichuan pepper.
Gently slide in tofu cubes and simmer.
Top with green onion and eat over rice.

recipes.name: Tomato egg stir-fry
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs hugged by juicy tomatoes.
steps: Scramble eggs softly and set aside.
Cook chopped tomatoes with salt and sugar until saucy.
Return eggs and fold gently.
Finish with green onion.

recipes.name: Soy braised chicken thighs
recipes.description: Chicken thighs simmered in soy, ginger, and a hint of five-spice.
steps: Brown chicken thighs in oil.
Add ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, five-spice, and a splash of water.
Cover and simmer until tender, turning once.
Reduce the sauce and scatter green onion.

recipes.name: Fridge fried rice
recipes.description: Cold rice revived with egg, peas, and whatever greens you have.
steps: Scramble eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry carrot and peas, then add cold rice.
Season with soy sauce and white pepper.
Fold eggs and green onion back in.

recipes.name: Quick red lentil dal
recipes.description: Soft red lentils finished with cumin and garlic oil.
steps: Simmer rinsed lentils with turmeric until soft and porridge-like.
In a small pan, bloom cumin and garlic in oil, then add onion and tomato.
Stir the tempered spices into the dal and salt to taste.
Finish with cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Spinach paneer skillet
recipes.description: Paneer cubes in a quick spinach and onion sauce.
steps: Brown paneer cubes lightly and set aside.
Cook onion, garlic, and ginger with cumin and garam masala.
Wilt spinach, then blend or chop into a sauce.
Return paneer, add cream if using, and warm through.

recipes.name: Yogurt chicken skillet
recipes.description: Chicken thighs marinated in yogurt and spices, then pan-cooked.
steps: Coat chicken in yogurt and spices; rest 10 minutes if you can.
Sear in a hot pan until browned on both sides.
Lower heat, cover, and finish cooking through.
Squeeze lemon over and rest briefly before serving.

recipes.name: Chickpea tomato masala
recipes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato gravy.
steps: Cook onion until golden, then add garlic, ginger, and spices.
Pour in tomatoes and simmer until thick.
Add chickpeas and a splash of water; cook 10 minutes.
Salt to taste and top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Potato cauliflower sabzi
recipes.description: Dry-spiced potatoes and cauliflower for a hearty side or main.
steps: Cube potatoes and break cauliflower into florets.
Fry cumin in oil, then onion.
Add vegetables with turmeric and salt; cover to steam-cook.
Uncover to dry out, dust garam masala, and add cilantro.

recipes.name: Spiced scrambled eggs
recipes.description: Eggs scrambled with onion, tomato, and chili for breakfast or dinner.
steps: Soft-cook onion, tomato, and chili in oil.
Add turmeric and salt.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble softly.
Finish with cilantro.

recipes.name: Garlic chili spaghetti
recipes.description: Spaghetti slicked with garlic, chili flakes, and olive oil.
steps: Boil spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente.
Warm olive oil with sliced garlic and chili flakes until fragrant.
Toss pasta with the oil and a splash of cooking water.
Add parsley and Parmesan if you have them.

recipes.name: Fresh tomato basil pasta
recipes.description: Ripe tomatoes and basil melted into a quick pasta sauce.
steps: Cook pasta until just tender.
Sizzle garlic in olive oil, then add chopped tomatoes.
Simmer until saucy and season with salt and pepper.
Toss pasta with sauce and torn basil; add Parmesan.

recipes.name: Caprese plate
recipes.description: Tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil with a drizzle of oil.
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Layer with basil leaves on a plate.
Drizzle olive oil and season.
Add a touch of balsamic if you like.

recipes.name: Mushroom risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice with browned mushrooms.
steps: Brown mushrooms in oil and set aside.
Soft-cook onion and garlic in butter, then toast the rice.
Add warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring until creamy.
Fold mushrooms back in with Parmesan and salt.

recipes.name: Sausage and peppers
recipes.description: Browned sausages with sweet peppers and onion.
steps: Brown sausages in olive oil, then set aside.
Cook peppers and onion until soft and sweet.
Add garlic and oregano, then return sausages.
Cover briefly to finish cooking and season.

recipes.name: Tuna white bean bowl
recipes.description: No-cook bowl of tuna, beans, lemon, and herbs.
steps: Drain tuna and beans into a bowl.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Fold in parsley and thin red onion if using.
Eat with toast or on its own.

recipes.name: Black bean tacos
recipes.description: Warm tortillas filled with spiced black beans and toppings.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, then add beans, cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Mash lightly so the filling holds together.
Warm tortillas and fill with beans.
Top with avocado, cilantro, and lime.

recipes.name: Chicken fajita skillet
recipes.description: Strips of chicken with peppers and onion for wrapping.
steps: Toss chicken strips with spices and salt.
Sear chicken, then cook peppers and onion in the same pan.
Combine everything and squeeze lime over.
Serve in warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Migas scramble
recipes.description: Eggs scrambled with tortilla chips, salsa, and cheese.
steps: Warm salsa in a pan with a little oil.
Add eggs and soft scramble.
Fold in crushed chips and cheddar until melty.
Top with cilantro and avocado.

recipes.name: Corn elote salad
recipes.description: Charred corn kernels with lime, chili, and creamy yogurt.
steps: Char corn in a hot dry pan until speckled.
Stir yogurt with lime juice, chili powder, and salt.
Toss corn in the dressing.
Top with cilantro and crumbled feta.

recipes.name: Chili lime shrimp tacos
recipes.description: Quick shrimp with chili and lime tucked into tortillas.
steps: Toss shrimp with chili powder, garlic, salt, and oil.
Sear quickly until pink.
Squeeze lime over and warm tortillas.
Fill with shrimp, shredded cabbage, and cilantro.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan chicken dinner
recipes.description: Chicken thighs roasted with potatoes and broccoli.
steps: Heat the oven hot and toss potatoes with oil, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken to the pan and roast until nearly done.
Scatter broccoli and garlic, then finish roasting.
Rest a few minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Skillet tuna melt
recipes.description: Toasty bread topped with tuna and melted cheddar.
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise, pepper, and minced onion if using.
Butter bread and toast one side in a pan.
Pile tuna and cheddar on the untoasted side.
Cover until cheese melts.

recipes.name: Fridge veggie omelette
recipes.description: Eggs folded around spinach, cheese, and leftover veg.
steps: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Sauté any veg in butter, then pour in eggs.
Scatter spinach and cheese, fold when set.
Slide onto a plate while still soft inside.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli
recipes.description: A takeout-style skillet of beef steak and broccoli.
steps: Slice beef thin and toss with cornstarch.
Sear beef hot, then set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli and garlic with a splash of water.
Return beef with soy sauce and sugar until glossy.

recipes.name: Loaded baked potatoes
recipes.description: Fluffy potatoes topped with yogurt, cheese, and greens.
steps: Bake or microwave the potatoes until the centers are soft.
Split them open and fluff the insides with butter, salt, and pepper.
Spoon on yogurt and shredded cheddar.
Finish with green onion and cooked bacon if you have it.

recipes.name: Butter garlic noodles
recipes.description: Rich garlic butter noodles with a splash of fish sauce.
steps: Cook noodles until tender and reserve a splash of water.
Melt butter with minced garlic until fragrant.
Toss noodles with soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar.
Loosen with pasta water and top with green onion.

recipes.name: Lemongrass chicken
recipes.description: Chicken thighs fragrant with lemongrass and fish sauce.
steps: Chop lemongrass, garlic, and shallots finely.
Coat chicken with the aromatics, fish sauce, and sugar.
Pan-cook until browned and cooked through.
Rest briefly and squeeze lime over.

recipes.name: Herb shrimp spring rolls
recipes.description: Rice paper rolls with shrimp, noodles, and lots of herbs.
steps: Cook shrimp and soak rice noodles until soft.
Dip rice paper in warm water until flexible.
Layer lettuce, herbs, cucumber, noodles, and shrimp, then roll tight.
Stir peanut butter with a little hoisin and water for dipping.

recipes.name: Caramel pork bites
recipes.description: Pork simmered in a salty-sweet caramel sauce.
steps: Cube pork and brown lightly.
Melt sugar in the pan until amber, then carefully add fish sauce and a splash of water.
Add garlic, shallots, and pork; simmer until glossy.
Crack black pepper and top with green onion.

recipes.name: Tomato tofu simmer
recipes.description: Fried tofu softens in a bright tomato sauce.
steps: Fry tofu cubes until golden.
Cook garlic and tomatoes into a sauce with fish sauce, sugar, and salt.
Return tofu to simmer gently.
Finish with green onion.

recipes.name: Lemon chickpea salad
recipes.description: Chickpeas, cucumber, and herbs in a lemony olive oil dressing.
steps: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and parsley.
Toss with chickpeas, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.
Crumble feta over if using.
Rest five minutes so flavors mingle.

recipes.name: Garlic lemon shrimp
recipes.description: Shrimp sautéed in olive oil with garlic and lemon.
steps: Warm olive oil with garlic and chili flakes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon and season with salt.
Scatter parsley and serve with bread or rice.

recipes.name: Hummus grain bowl
recipes.description: Quick homemade-style chickpea mash with cucumber and pita.
steps: Mash chickpeas with tahini, lemon, garlic, salt, and olive oil.
Warm pita and slice cucumber.
Spoon hummus into bowls with cucumber.
Dust paprika and drizzle more oil.

recipes.name: Tomato feta bake
recipes.description: Roasted tomatoes and feta stirred into hot pasta.
steps: Roast tomatoes, garlic, and a block of feta with olive oil until soft.
Boil pasta until al dente.
Mash the tray into a sauce and toss with pasta.
Season and finish with basil.

recipes.name: Lemon herb chicken
recipes.description: Chicken breast with lemon, oregano, and olive oil.
steps: Coat chicken with olive oil, lemon zest and juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Sear in a pan, then lower heat to finish.
Optionally roast zucchini alongside.
Rest and slice against the grain.
